article.en: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
article.zh: 杰里米·汉普登交际很广，在聚会上很受欢迎。

article.en: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour, everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
article.zh: 每个人都钦佩他的幽默感，也就是说，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮之外。

article.en: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
article.zh: 最近，杰里米的一位密友请他在婚礼招待会上讲话。

article.en: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
article.zh: 这正是杰里米喜欢做的事。

article.en: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
article.zh: 他认真准备了演讲稿，带着珍妮去参加婚礼。

article.en: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
article.zh: 他在演讲中加进了大量滑稽故事，演讲当然非常成功。

article.en: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
article.zh: 他一讲完，珍妮就告诉他她想回家。

article.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
article.zh: 杰里米对此有点失望，但还是照女儿的话做了。

article.en: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
article.zh: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢他的演讲。

article.en: To his surprise, she said she had not, because she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
article.zh: 使他吃惊的是，她说她不喜欢，因为她不愿看到那么多人嘲笑他！
